g.text: Read left to right. Input enters. Output ships. Four stations on one line.

text.tspan: Install one automated check in 30 days.

g.text: Today, and a Monday in six months at current trajectory
Same scene. Lighting changes. The bleed is the lesson.

text.tspan: CFO asks ROI. You have no defensible number.
Six months of volume. The same missing parts now bleed in public.

g.text: FRAME 03 — MOBILE STACK (375PX, VERTICAL LINE TOP-DOWN)
Same factory, read top to bottom
German engineers read schematics top-down too. Same metaphor. No information lost.
- Belt runs vertical, top to bottom.
- Each station alternates left/right of belt for breathing room.
- Weakest station gets the only accent.
- Status chip lives inside the station card.
- Verdict line sits below the device, not as a black bar.
- "No": station stays ghost outline. No shake.
- Missing stations gain hairline crack, leak drops.
- Present stations gain soft glow. Scene does not move.
